title: Speech bubble at the pointer
hint: Move the pointer over the dashed box: a speech bubble follows it. Go towards the right or bottom edge: the bubble jumps to the other side and its tail changes the corner. The Calculated values show the placement (itemAt).
tweak: In the JavaScript tab, remove flip and stick and try again.

scenarios.name: the bubble sits below right of the pointer when there is room
the bubble moves to the other side at the right and bottom edge
